frames.title: Shape inquiry into a narrative argument
frames.summary: Documentary structure should reveal meaning through selection, contrast, and accumulation of evidence.
principles: Define the central question early so viewers know what evidence matters.
Alternate exposition with lived moments that humanize the thesis.
Let contradictions stay visible when they deepen credibility.
End by widening implication, not merely restating facts.
patterns: Use chapter turns when the question itself evolves.
Pair macro context with intimate witness detail.
antiPatterns: Do not stack interviews without progression in viewpoint.
Do not force certainty where the material is meaningfully unresolved.

frames.title: Use act outs to drive return behavior
frames.summary: Television pacing depends on mini-climaxes that reset curiosity without exhausting the main arc.
principles: Each act should own a dramatic objective and reversal.
Act outs should sharpen a question, threat, or revelation.
A and B stories should trade momentum instead of peaking simultaneously.
Episode endings should satisfy the week while feeding the series engine.
patterns: Use act boundaries to hand focus between plotlines.
Seed future payoff before the final button.
antiPatterns: Do not make act outs feel like arbitrary ad-break spikes.
Do not starve the cold open of story purpose.

frames.title: Balance momentum with emotional dwell time
frames.summary: Anime pacing often alternates propulsion with reflective beats that deepen attachment and anticipation.
principles: Give climactic actions enough runway to feel ceremonial, not abrupt.
Use pauses, looks, and reaction chains to heighten emotional charge.
Escalate battles or reveals through changing meaning, not only scale.
Let episode endings crystallize feeling as much as plot.
patterns: Use quiet aftermath scenes to convert spectacle into memory.
Employ recurring motifs to make build-up feel intentional.
antiPatterns: Do not stretch repetition past emotional gain.
Do not speed through aftermath and expect impact to linger.
